hero.title: Hello! I am Libní Gonzaléz
intro: since 2022. I have training and academic accreditations in Neuropsychology, gained through various studies, including a
Master's in Neuroscience Applied to Psychology
and several international diplomas in Neuropsychology. This allows me to integrate a clinical and neuroscientific approach in my work.

services.title: Services
subtitle: As a
Clinical Psychologist
I offer professional support to people looking to improve their emotional well-being and face different challenges in their lives.
All my sessions are held online
, allowing greater comfort, flexibility, and accessibility for my patients.
method: A safe and confidential space to work on emotions, thoughts, and behaviors affecting your well-being.
Techniques and strategies to manage worries, tension, and anxiety symptoms.
Learning practical tools for emotional and mental balance.

about.title: About me
about.background: I consider myself a person who is always seeking knowledge and is passionate about understanding how different disciplines work. I have a deep interest in science and art, which regularly leads me to take part in activities that bring both fields together.
about.interest: My main interest in psychology has always been the deep understanding and effective treatment of different psychological problems and disorders.

contact.title: Sessions
footer: From anywhere and from the comfort of your home, we can begin online therapy.
